text: Good evening, I'm very sorry to be troubling you at this hour. I'm looking after my granddaughter, she's 10, and her temperature tonight is 38.6. She has a rash on her arms and chest. I remembered about the glass, so I pressed a tumbler on it and the spots went pale underneath, they faded right out. In between her doses of ibuprofen she has been perfectly chirpy, watching her programmes, drinking her juice and nattering away to me. Her breathing is normal, nice and easy. I expect I'm fussing over nothing, my daughter usually handles these things. Apologies again for taking up your time.
